sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Venmo (PayPal)
  • 한 줄 정체성: 친구끼리 송금하는 소셜 페이먼트 — 미국 P2P 결제 표준
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Pay with personality — social, friendly, fast"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: 공식 Venmo Blue(#008CFF) 워드마크 + 송금 메모의 emoji + 친구 중심 활동 피드
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 친근함, 소셜, 송금
  • 무드 설명: 밝은 캔버스 위에 선명한 Venmo Blue를 행동 색으로 사용하고, 송금 내역을 친구 중심 피드처럼 표시한다. 결제·요청·잔액 관리가 가볍고 사회적인 경험으로 이어진다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 휴머니즘
  • 밀도(Density): Comfortable
  • 모서리 성향: Round (12~16px)
  • 평면성: Subtle

sections.⑨:
Button

.btn {
  font: 700 14px/1 'Venmo Sans', Inter, 'Pretendard', sans-serif;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  padding: 0 22px;
  height: 44px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 0;
  transition: background 100ms ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input { background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 15px; }
.input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

Card (Activity card)

.card { background: var(--bg-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 14px; }
.card-elevated { background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.card-outlined { background: var(--bg-base); border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }

Badge

.tag { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.tag-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.tag-subtle  { background: var(--color-primary-50); color: var(--color-primary-700); }
.tag-outline { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); }

Navigation

.topnav { padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.topnav .brand { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
sections.⑪: 1. brand blue를 destructive 액션에 사용 금지 2. 송금 description에서 emoji 제거 금지 — Venmo의 사회적 톤 핵심 3. venmo 워드마크를 대문자로 변경 금지 — 소문자 워드마크가 표준 4. 활동 피드를 단순 거래 리스트로 단조롭게 표시 금지 — 좋아요/댓글이 있어야 함 5. 본문에 채도 높은 그라데이션 배경 금지

<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Venmo Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Pretendard', sans-serif;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    background: var(--bg-base);
  }
  button { font: inherit; }
  .venmo-demo {
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 3%, rgba(0,140,255,.16), transparent 28%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-base) 0%, var(--color-primary-50) 100%);
  }
  .vn-nav {
    width: min(1120px, calc(100% - 40px));
    height: 72px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 30px;
  }
  .vn-logo {
    color: var(--color-primary-500);
    font-size: 31px;
    line-height: 1;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-style: italic;
    letter-spacing: -1.8px;
  }
  .vn-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
  .vn-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#FFD86F,#FF8A72); color: #492518; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
  .vn-hero {
    width: min(1120px, calc(100% - 40px));
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 68px 0 72px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.04fr .96fr;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 76px;
  }
  .vn-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-primary-700); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
  .vn-kicker::before { content: 'V'; width: 25px; height: 25px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text-on-primary); background: var(--color-primary-500); font-style: italic; }
  .vn-copy h1 { max-width: 620px; margin: 18px 0 20px; font-size: clamp(48px,7vw,82px); line-height: .96; letter-spacing: -.065em; }
  .vn-copy h1 em { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-style: normal; }
  .vn-copy p { max-width: 520px; margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.65; }
  .vn-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 30px; }
  .vn-primary, .vn-secondary { min-height: 50px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); padding: 0 23px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; }
  .vn-primary { border: 0; color: var(--text-on-primary); background: var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,140,255,.24); }
  .vn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .vn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-elevated); }
  .vn-proof { margin-top: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
  .vn-proof-avatars { display: flex; }
  .vn-proof-avatars span { width: 25px; height: 25px; margin-left: -6px; border: 2px solid var(--bg-base); border-radius: var(--radius-full); }
  .vn-proof-avatars span:first-child { margin-left: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#8EDBFF,#008CFF); }
  .vn-proof-avatars span:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FF8A72,#FFD86F); }
  .vn-proof-avatars span:nth-child(3) { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#B6F0D0,#24A968); }
  .vn-phone-wrap { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; }
  .vn-orbit { position: absolute; width: 460px; height: 460px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,140,255,.17); border-radius: var(--radius-full); }
  .vn-orbit::before, .vn-orbit::after { content: ''; position: absolute; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,140,255,.28); }
  .vn-orbit::before { width: 14px; height: 14px; top: 57px; left: 57px; }
  .vn-orbit::after { width: 9px; height: 9px; right: 25px; bottom: 116px; }
  .vn-phone {
    position: relative;
    width: min(330px, 88vw);
    padding: 11px;
    border: 1px solid #D8E2EA;
    border-radius: 38px;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 60px rgba(0,45,67,.19), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,45,67,.08);
    transform: rotate(2deg);
  }
  .vn-screen { min-height: 500px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 29px; background: #F7F9FC; }
  .vn-status { height: 28px; padding: 9px 18px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #001C33; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; }
  .vn-appbar { padding: 10px 18px 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; background: #FFFFFF; border-bottom: 1px solid #E7EDF2; }
  .vn-appbar .vn-logo { font-size: 22px; }

  .vn-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px; }

  .vn-quick button:last-child { border: 1px solid #B8DFFF; color: var(--color-primary-500); background: #FFFFFF; }
  .vn-feed-title { padding: 18px 16px 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; color: #001C33; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
  .vn-feed-title span { color: var(--color-primary-500); font-size: 10px; }
  .vn-activity { margin: 0 14px 9px; padding: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #E7EDF2; border-radius: 15px; background: #FFFFFF; }
  .vn-person { flex: 0 0 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-full); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; }
  .vn-person.blue { background: linear-gradient(145deg,#7ED9FF,#008CFF); }
  .vn-person.coral { background: linear-gradient(145deg,#FFB477,#F26B6B); }
  .vn-activity-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; color: #001C33; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; }
  .vn-activity-copy span { color: #667785; }
  .vn-amount { color: #08783E; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
  .vn-amount.out { color: #001C33; }
  .vn-section { width: min(1120px, calc(100% - 40px)); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 80px; }
  .vn-section-head { margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; align-items: end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; }
  .vn-section h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 30px; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
  .vn-section-head p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 14px; }
  .vn-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 16px; }
  .vn-card { min-height: 220px; padding: 22px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .vn-card-icon { width: 43px; height: 43px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 14px; color: var(--color-primary-600); background: var(--color-primary-50); }
  .vn-card h3 { margin: 31px 0 8px; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .vn-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .vn-card .vn-chip { position: absolute; right: 18px; top: 19px; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); color: var(--color-primary-700); background: var(--color-primary-50); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; }
  .vn-card:first-child { border-color: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; background: var(--color-primary-500); box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,140,255,.2); }
  .vn-card:first-child .vn-card-icon { color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); }
  .vn-card:first-child p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); }
  .vn-card:first-child .vn-chip { color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(255,255,255,.16); }
  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .vn-links { display: none; }
    .vn-hero { padding-top: 40px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 54px; text-align: center; }
    .vn-copy p { margin-inline: auto; }
